The duties and responsibilities for a IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC) GS-2210-13 generally include, but are not limited to, the following: Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, reliability, resiliency, operational readiness, and service dependencies; resolve complex operational issues.

Coordinate with budget, acquisition, contracting, program, and technical personnel to ensure effective management of IT resources. Develop network project plans, technical requirements, implementation strategies, schedules, milestones, and resource requirements.

Provide technical recommendations to contracting officials regarding contract administration, modifications, deliverable acceptance, schedule changes, and performance issues. Lead cross-functional teams of technical staff, program officials, contractors, vendors, and internal/external stakeholders.
To qualify for the position of IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC), at GS-2210-13, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below. Basic Qualifications (2210 series): Please refer to the OPM IT Management Series 2210 Qualification Standard for the specific experience requirements for the GS-12 and above positions.

AND Specialized Experience: To qualify for the GS-13 grade level, you must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service, or comparable non-Federal experience.

Specialized experience is defined as experience performing the following duties: Participate in the planning execution and monitoring enterprise IT projects involving network services, information security, and/or telecommunications. You MUST meet all qualification requirements by the 09/04/2026 of this announcement.

Your resume must support your responses to the application questionnaire and the qualification requirements. Failure to do so may result in an ineligible rating. See the Required Documents section for important notes about what must be included in your resume.

After you submit this application, you will receive an e-mail informing you that a USA Hire assessment is required of you. You will have 48 hours from the closing date of this announcement 09/04/2026 to complete the assessment as this assessment is part of your application.

Consist of and are not limited to the following duties of Information Technology Project Manager within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Healthcare Administration Electronic Health Records Modernization Integration Office, (EHRM-IO).

The incumbent manages, develops, coordinates, assesses, evaluates and monitors development schedules for applications assigned to Schedule and Risks.

Supports senior management with efforts to ensure adherence to required and appropriate development processes, change and configuration management processes within electronic healthcare records management.

Presents authoritative technical advice to management on the application of business or clinical process modeling, business or clinical object modeling and business or clinical task design activities Creates and maintains documentation as it relates to system configuration, mapping, processes and service records Participates in the creation of and reviews of technical documentation such as data migration plans, schedules, and user and technical manuals Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm Compressed/Flexible Schedule: May be available with supervisor approval.

Telework: May be available upon supervisor approval.

Duty Location Status: Will work from a VA owned or leased space Position Description Title/PD#: Information Technology Project Manager/PD210090 Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Financial Disclosure Report: Not Required Travel: May be required to travel up to 25% of the time Location: Location Negotiable Supervisory: No Physical Requirements: Work is primarily sedentary but involves use of a government furnished computer so a degree of manual dexterity and visual acuity sufficient to utilize these tools are required.

Some physical effort is required in that the incumbent lifts and carries reference books, working papers and similar items to and from meetings. A moderate amount of standing and walking is required in getting to and from meeting places away from the work site. The work does not require any special physical effort.

VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Total Rewards
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 07/24/2026.

For the GS-14: To meet the Competency-Based Qualification Standard for the Information Technology (IT) Management Series (2210), you must possess: Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Decision Making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.

Information Management - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.

Interpersonal Skills - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Teamwork - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence - Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

AND Specialized Experience: GS-14 grade level: One year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-13 grade level in the federal service); experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities (KSA's) and other characteristics to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled, in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Specialized experience for this position includes but is not limited to: Leading project teams in advanced systems software/hardware project efforts.

Functioning as a technical authority in project management disciplines such as requirements analysis, project planning, budgeting, cost analysis, configuration management, data management, information systems and network security assignments. Planning and designing systems architecture as they relate to Electronic Healthcare Records Management.

Assuring software and systems functionality and quality. Ensuring extensive application of security/information assurance policies, principles, and practices to the delivery of application software services.

Applying project management principles to large-scale, complex projects which entail the methods, metrics, tools, and techniques of Electronic Health Records Management.

OR Applicants may also be considered to have satisfied the minimum qualification requirements for a position if they can present evidence that clearly justifies a high evaluation of their competence, such as one or more of the following: Appropriate licensure, registration(s), certification(s); or A substantial record of experience, achievement, and publications that demonstrates eminence in the appropriate profession/technical field.

Applicants can qualify fully on the basis of licensure, certification, registration, or special training as an alternative to experience. NOTE: Evidence of claimed competence must be substantiated in your resume and upload copies of applicable certifications, licensures, registrations, etc, as supporting documentation.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

The position serves as a Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist for all BARD patron-facing products in the Patron Engagement Section (PES), Patron and Network Engagement Division, National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS), Library Collections and Services Group.

As the Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist, you will: Serve as the subject matter expert in the development, implementation, and distribution of all versions of the product.

Review and analyze all BARD patron-facing products to ensure continuity in operation, consistency in delivery, high-level of accessibility, and that all patron considerations have been met. Coordinate all patron-facing customer service and technical support for all BARD products.

This includes BARD on the web, BARD Mobile for iOS, BARD Mobile for Android, BARD Mobile for Fire Devices, BARD Express, Digital Advanced (DA2) Talking Book machine, and the My Talking Book Skill. Serve as the primary liaison between the various BARD initiatives, NLS patrons, and other NLS stakeholders. Perform other duties as assigned.

The position description number for this position is 467973. The salary range indicated reflects the locality pay adjustments for the Washington, D.C., Metropolitan area. The incumbent of this position will work a Flexitime work schedule. This is a non-supervisory, non-bargaining unit position.

Relocation expenses will not be authorized for the person(s) selected under this vacancy announcement.
Applicants must have had progressively responsible experience and training sufficient in scope and quality to furnish them with an acceptable level of the following knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position without more than normal supervision.

Ability to interact collaboratively, providing consultation and liaison services.** Ability to provide customer service planning and management work for a program. ** Ability to communicate in writing. Ability to utilize applicable information technology. Ability to communicate effectively other than in writing.

Candidate must possess the ability to pivot their waist and neck, push and pull items not greater than 35 pounds and reach within a five-foot distance or above shoulder height. The position requires sitting , squatting, standing, walking and twisting , alongside wrist flexion and extension.

Employees are expected to employ proper body mechanics during lifting. Requires adequate vision to accurately perform the assigned duties, distinguish basic colors and assess patients and the environment safely. The position requires the ability to hear at a level to perform the assigned duties and the use of hearing aids permitted.

Examples may include but are not limited to: Significant amounts of time standing assisting assigned patients Utilization of safe patient handling and mobility protocols

CodeWrights entwickelt individuelle Softwarelösungen für einige der weltweit führenden Industrieunternehmen. Als Spezialist für industrielle Software, Geräteintegration und digitale Produktentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, komplexe technische Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu lösen.
Du sorgst dafür, dass anspruchsvolle Software- und Entwicklungsprojekte zielgerichtet, transparent und verlässlich durch die Organisation geführt werden. Dabei koordinierst du Anforderungen, Ressourcen, Termine, Risiken und die Kommunikation zwischen allen Beteiligten und stellst sicher, dass Teams effizient zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam optimale Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln.
In deiner Rolle bist du weit mehr als klassischer PM: Du navigierst durch komplexe technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge, moderierst Entscheidungen, schaffst Transparenz und verbindest Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholder zu einem leistungsfähigen Projektumfeld. Dabei behältst du sowohl die Kundenanforderungen als auch wirtschaftliche Ziele und die Dynamik im Team im Blick.
Wir sind eine Expertenorganisation mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem modernen Dynamic-Work-Ansatz. Zusammenarbeit, Transparenz und Verantwortung dort, wo die Kompetenz liegt, prägen unsere Arbeitsweise.
Die Tür steht dir offen, wenn du Mut, Disziplin und die Fähigkeit mitbringst, anspruchsvolle Projekte erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu führen. Du verfügst über fundiertes technisches Verständnis und Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und gehst Themen nicht nur organisatorisch, sondern auch fachlich in der Tiefe an.

Idealerweise hast du einen Hintergrund in der Softwareentwicklung, Elektrotechnik oder einem ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Umfeld und dich gezielt in Richtung Projektmanagement weiterentwickelt. Mit deiner starken Kommunikationsfähigkeit verbindest du Menschen, schaffst Vertrauen und führst Projekte erfolgreich zum Ziel.
Die Position ist an unserem Standort in Karlsruhe angesiedelt.

At Novakid, we are on a mission to build the world’s best online education platform for children. With over 100,000 students and 4,000 teachers, Novakid is already one of the most popular language learning platforms for children aged 4–12 across Europe and Asia.

About the role We are building a new interactive entertainment project for families (parents + children) — with YouTube as the main platform and content home.

Short-form content (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) will serve as the acquisition engine: hooks, teasers, cliffhangers, and emotional moments designed to drive viewers to the main YouTube episodes.

You will own the creative direction for both long-form and short-form — ensuring every piece of content works together as a system, not separately. Before we invest in full production, we will first test concepts using short-form content to measure audience demand, engagement, and intent to watch longer episodes.

Cultural & Audience Insight Ensure concepts resonate with parents culturally and emotionally, with a focus on the TR market Anticipate cross-cultural interpretation, humor, and sensitivity Keep Novakid relevant to real parent conversations, not marketing narratives What you have done before (real experience we need) You have concepted and led production of long-form YouTube content (8–20+ min) — episodic, story-driven, with clear hooks and payoff.

You have successfully repurposed long-form content into short-form trailers/teasers that drove measurable traffic back to YouTube. You have tested content concepts using only short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) before investing in full episodes — and can show examples of how you made that decision.

You understand YouTube organic metrics (CTR, retention, AVD) and short-form metrics (completion rate, shares, comments) — and how they relate. You have worked on projects with participatory or community elements (even simple ones like comments shaping next steps). Key responsibilities YouTube first: Everything starts with the long-form episode.

Short-form serves it, not the other way around. Test fast: Use short-form to validate concepts before building full episodes. Own the creative vision from title/thumbnail to final frame of each episode. Collaborate with production teams but stay responsible for viral instincts and audience psychology.

Analyze performance across both formats and iterate quickly. Requirements Must-have qualifications Portfolio with long-form YouTube content you concepted (show retention, CTR, or growth if possible). Proven ability to drive traffic from short-form to long-form (examples required).

Deep understanding of TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts as acquisition tools, not standalone entertainment. Obsessed with hooks, pacing, cliffhangers, and payoff. Strong interest in parenting, family dynamics, or human stories involving children Requirements: Experience leading video projects from concept to final delivery.

Experience with family, parenting, or kids content. Basic editing or thumbnail design sense. Experience building a YouTube channel (other Social Media channels) from zero. The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do. Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplines—research, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.

Coordination . You’ll manage cross-functional teams of 5–10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea → build → launch → analysis. You’ll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Strategy & Planning. You’ll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10–20 upcoming experiments. You’ll communicate the “why” behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.

Energy (“Vibes”). You’re the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

Skills, Knowledge and Traits

You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Here’s what we need from you:

Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and don’t stop until things are finished properly.

Communication. You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it.

Smart and high agency. You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or don’t. You’re the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions.

What You’ll Get

Clear promotion opportunities. We invest heavily in training and promote almost exclusively from within. Most leaders at Spiralyze started in entry-level roles.

Tech reimbursement. Need a better computer, monitor, or setup? Want training on Figma or GA4? We’ll help.

In-demand skills. You’ll learn Conversion Rate Optimization from the most experienced experimentation teams in the world.

Time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.

If you’re excited about working with smart people, solving real problems, and growing fast in a merit-based environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und temporäre Arbeitskräfte effizient miteinander verbindet.

Unternehmen nutzen unsere Plattform, um kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende in Echtzeit zu buchen, während Studierende unsere App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Studierende und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist.

Sie ist das Ergebnis innovativer Technologie und echter Leidenschaft. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.
Über die Rolle
Als Program Manager im Talent Training & Enablement Team sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Zenjobber nicht einfach nur einen Job bekommen – sondern bestens vorbereitet, sicher und mit den richtigen Skills an den Start gehen. Du denkst Enablement end to end: von der allerersten Schicht bis zum nächsten Schritt auf der Karriereleiter. Du baust die Programme, die unsere Talents wirklich weiterbringen – kreativ, datengetrieben und mit echtem Gespür für Menschen.
Deine Aufgaben
End-to-end Ownership: Du verantwortest Enablement- und Upskilling-Initiativen von der ersten Idee über Konzept und Rollout bis zur Messung des Impacts.
Programme entlang des Lifecycles: Du entwickelst Trainings- und Lernformate für jeden Schritt der Talent Journey - vom Onboarding über die erste Schicht bis zum gezielten Upskilling erfahrener Zenjobber.
Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Product und weiteren Teams zusammen, um Enablement nahtlos in unsere Prozesse einzubetten.
Impact messbar machen: Du definierst die richtigen KPIs, analysierst, was funktioniert, und iterierst mutig statt im Blindflug zu fliegen.
Skalierbar bauen: Du schaffst nachhaltige Strukturen und automatisierst dort, wo es Sinn ergibt, damit gute Lösungen mit uns mitwachsen.
LMS-Admin: Du teilst dir die Administration, Konfiguration und kontinuierliche Optimierung unseres Learning Management System (LMS) mit dem Team.
Weitere Tools: Nutzung und Pflege von Google Suite, LMS, Asana, n8n und internen Systemen.
Dein Profil
Erfahrung: 1–3 Jahre im Programm-/Projektmanagement, Learning & Development, Enablement, Operations oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle - gerne in einem schnell wachsenden Startup.
Projektmanagement-Skills: Du strukturierst komplexe Initiativen, jonglierst mehrere Stakeholder und lieferst zuverlässig ab – auch wenn alles gleichzeitig kommt.
Kreativität & Neugier: Du liebst es, Neues zu gestalten, und fragst instinktiv „Wie könnte das noch besser gehen?“.
Struktur & Organisationstalent: Wo andere Chaos sehen, schaffst du Klarheit, Übersicht und ein sauberes Setup.
Kommunikations- & didaktisches Gespür: Du bringst komplexe Inhalte einfach und ansprechend rüber. Egal ob im Trainingskonzept, im Workshop oder im Stakeholder-Update.
Datenaffinität: Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und scheust dich nicht, Wirkung zu messen.
Ownership & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und kommst ins Machen, statt auf den perfekten Plan zu warten.
Sprachen: Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Erfahrung in Learning & Development, Instructional Design oder der Konzeption von Trainings, sowie der Betreuung, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von LMS-Systemen.
Erfahrung mit Marketplace-Geschäftsmodellen, wo B2C und B2B aufeinandertreffen.
Erste Erfahrung mit KI- & Automatisierungs-Tools.

Unseren Kunden bieten wir Design auf Subscription-Basis über 3 maßgeschneiderte Abo Modelle an. Über einen zentralen, agilen Workflow liefern wir Ergebnisse schnell, konsistent und ohne das häufige Projektchaos.
Aufgaben
Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Design-Team strukturiert, unseren kundennahen Subscription-Workflow koordiniert und als kompetenter Ansprechpartner an der Kundenschnittstelle agiert.

Schnittstelle & Kommunikation: Du bist das zentrale Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und dem internen UX/UI-Design-Team.
Anforderungsmanagement: Du nimmst Kundenwünsche in Meetings auf, hinterfragst diese kritisch und übersetzt sie in klare, verständliche Briefings für die Designer.
Projektkoordination: Du steuerst Design-Sprints, überwachst Timelines und organisierst die internen Feedbackschleifen.
Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Kunden-Präsentationen, moderierst Abstimmungstermine und stellst sicher, dass die Erwartungen auf beiden Seiten matchen.
Qualifikation
Passendes Studium: Du studierst aktuell im Master (z. B. UX-Design & Management, Design-Management, Strategic Design, oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang).
Kommunikationstalent: Du hast großen Spaß am direkten Kundenkontakt, trittst professionell sowie selbstsicher auf und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte einfach erklären.
Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch bei parallelen Projekten den Überblick und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für ein dynamisches Startup-Umfeld mit.
Konzeptionelles UX-Verständnis: Da dein Schwerpunkt in der Organisation und Kommunikation liegt, steht ein Design-Portfolio für uns nicht im Vordergrund. Wichtig ist uns jedoch, dass du UX-Methoden und die Logik von Designsystemen tiefgreifend verstehst, um mit Kunden und Designern auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren.
Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine sichere und fließende Kommunikation auf Englisch (in Wort und Schrift).

Flexibilität: Die Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro im Herzen Münchens oder nach Absprache Remote zu arbeiten, um Job und Studium optimal zu vereinbaren.
Projekt-Impact mit Sinn: Unser Anspruch endet nicht beim Design. Wir verbinden effektive Gestaltung mit sozialer und ökologischer Verantwortung. Mit unserer Arbeit unterstützen wir unter anderem den Schutz von Ökosystemen und die Stärkung indigener Gemeinschaften in Südamerika und Asien.
Mitgestaltung: Die Möglichkeit, die operativen Strukturen und Workflows einer wachsenden Designagentur von Grund auf aktiv mitzugestalten.
Teamkultur: Ein ambitioniertes Team, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedbackkultur auf Augenhöhe.
Entwicklung: Eine steile Lernkurve im Bereich Design Operations und agilem Projektmanagement sowie regelmäßiger, direkter Austausch mit den Gründern.
Die Rolle und unsere Philosophie sprechen dich an, du bist dir jedoch nicht sicher, ob du alle Punkte erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem – möglicherweise bringst du genau das mit, von dem wir noch gar nicht wissen, dass wir es brauchen.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction des soins incarne l-autorité en matière de soins. Elle a pour mission de garantir la qualité et la sécurité des soins au sein de l'établissement. A ce titre, la Direction des soins a droit de regard sur l-ensemble des activités des soins (infirmiers, infirmières et différents corps professionnels de santé).

Pour remplir sa mission, elle s-appuie sur trois pôles d'expertises : qualité, durabilité et innovation digitale ; expertise clinique et pratiques professionnelles ; management et transformation.
## Description du poste ##
La direction des soins est à la recherche de son ou sa future responsable diététicienne pour manager et accompagner les équipes sur le site de Cluse-Roseraie dans leurs prestations dans différents départements médicaux. La patientèle peut être adulte comme pédiatrique notamment dans le domaine des soins aigus ainsi que pour l-enseignement thérapeutique au décours de la maladie chronique.
Vous dirigez une équipe d-environ 30 collaborateurs et collaboratrices. Vous organisez, coordonnez et supervisez leurs activités et prévoyez toute action nécessaire de développement des compétences individuelles comme collectives. Vous garantissez une circulation optimale des informations, qu-elle soit ascendante, descendante et/ ou transversale. Vous développez un climat de confiance dans l-équipe nécessaire au bien vivre et travailler ensemble dans le respect des valeurs institutionnelles.
Vous savez donner le cap et accompagner vos équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs. Vous déclinez les axes stratégiques de votre métier en objectifs réalisables par l-équipe tout en veillant à la contribution individuelle de chaque membre.
En qualité de responsable d-équipe, vous êtes garante ou garant de la qualité des soins nutritionnels et promouvez toute mesure visant à optimiser et à améliorer les prestations offertes à la patientèle. Vous disposez d-indicateurs pour conduire l-amélioration continue de la qualité. Vous contribuez également au développement de nouvelles pratiques.
Votre esprit collaboratif vous permet de soutenir et développer l-interdisciplinarité entre tous les professionnelles et professionnels de la santé agissant sur la prise en charge des patientes et patients.
Vous gérez aisément la bonne allocation des ressources comme du matériel pour répondre aux besoins en soins des patients et patientes dans le cadre du budget alloué. Vous exercez également un rôle de référente ou référent pour les systèmes tarifaires en lien avec la profession
Selon les besoins, vous êtes amené ou amenée à recruter de nouvelles collaboratrices et collaborateurs et veillez au développement de leur expertise dans les champs de spécialité de chaque secteur tout en veillant à la polyvalence nécessaire des compétences

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en nutrition et diététique ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée en management, acquise au travers d'au moins cinq années de pratique dans le domaine hospitalier. Une formation en management, telle qu'un CAS en management des institutions de santé, constitue un atout.
Dotée ou doté d'excellentes qualités relationnelles, vous faites preuve d'entregent et d'une communication positive. Vous savez fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et instaurer un climat de collaboration propice au bon fonctionnement du service.
Ouvert ou ouverte au changement, vous êtes capable d'accompagner les évolutions de votre environnement professionnel avec pragmatisme. Vous savez également prendre du recul sur vos pratiques managériales afin de les faire évoluer de manière continue.
Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre flexibilité et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement où les activités sont variées et transversales.
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et possédez une excellente maîtrise de la langue française.

Global Trials Optimization Specialist
Sponsor Dedicated/ Remote - US only
Are you energized by using data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration to help clinical trials enroll successfully? We’re seeking a Global Trials Optimization Specialist to support program feasibility, recruitment and retention planning, and in-life trial optimization across global clinical studies.
In this role, you’ll help translate trial goals, country input, modeling data, and enrollment insights into practical strategies that support study execution. You’ll partner with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other stakeholders to identify enrollment opportunities, address challenges, and support patient- and site-facing recruitment efforts.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining clinical trial operations, feasibility strategy, recruitment planning, stakeholder coordination, and performance analysis to help studies reach the right participants.

Program Feasibility and Trial Optimization
Gather data, benchmarks, and modeling inputs to support feasibility and trial optimization planning.
Support program review development, including content review and escalation of requirements as needed.
Plan timelines for validation, deliverable development, stakeholder alignment, presentation preparation, and country validation requests.
Support validation and Clinical Trials Allocation Committee activities, including scenario planning, risk table inputs, validation review, modeling updates, and final allocation requests.
Author the initial Global Trials Optimization Report and maintain subsequent report updates throughout the trial lifecycle.
Complete recruitment needs assessments and ensure trial-level GTO reports remain current and actionable.
Recruitment and Retention Planning
Lead early recruitment and retention planning during feasibility, including inputs for project cost estimates.
Develop initial recruitment needs assessments and, where applicable, program-level recruitment budget estimates.
Submit vendor requests and prepare recruitment and retention plans.
Partner with legal on concept reviews, vendor proposal reviews, scope of work finalization, and material or tactic reviews.
Ensure recruitment and retention plans, including enrollment support materials, are implemented effectively.
Oversee enrollment support material development and tactic execution.
Provide required materials to the Metrics, Analytics & Performance team to support accurate Study Optimizer plan entry.
Request and manage appropriate system updates as trial needs evolve.
In-Life Trial Management
Partner with study teams to identify enrollment challenges, assess risks, and recommend potential mitigations.
Manage routine enrollment support materials and vendor activities.
Monitor enrollment performance and prepare standard reporting.
Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for enhanced support.
Coordinate enhanced enrollment support activities, which may include:
Rescue site and country activities
Internal recruitment and retention refresher meetings
External recruitment and retention booster meetings
Additional participant- or site-facing materials
Rescue vendor engagement
Advocacy engagement and community outreach

Experience supporting clinical trials, feasibility, recruitment planning, enrollment strategy, or trial optimization.
Strong ability to gather, interpret, and apply data to support planning and decision-making.
Experience coordinating timelines, deliverables, stakeholder reviews, and cross-functional inputs.
Ability to work with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other business partners.
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to develop clear reports, plans, updates, and study-facing materials.
Detail-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced clinical research environment.

Oncology clinical trial experience, especially in lung or breast cancer studies .
Prior experience as an oncology site coordinator .
Experience with recruitment and retention vendors, enrollment support materials, or patient/site-facing recruitment tactics.
Familiarity with enrollment monitoring, performance analysis, country validation, risk tables, or trial allocation processes.
Why This Role Matters
Successful clinical trials depend on reaching the right participants, supporting sites effectively, and responding quickly when enrollment challenges arise. As a Global Trials Optimization Specialist, your work will directly support smarter planning, stronger recruitment strategies, and more effective trial execution.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence global study planning, collaborate with experienced clinical research partners, and help improve how trials connect with patients and sites.
Candidate Profile
We’re especially interested in candidates with oncology trial experience and a strong understanding of site operations, enrollment strategy, and recruitment/retention planning. Internal candidates will be prioritized initially; external candidates may be considered after the initial internal review period.
If you’re a clinical research professional who enjoys bringing structure, insight, and strategy to trial enrollment planning, we’d like to hear from you. Apply today to help support meaningful clinical trials through thoughtful feasibility, recruitment, and optimization work.

* Design, launch, and continuously improve digital customer success programs across the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, customer education, AI feature adoption, customer maturity progression, renewal readiness, and customer advocacy.
* Own the digital experience for tech-touch and scaled customer segments while enabling high-touch Customer Success Managers with automated engagement programs, customer intelligence, and repeatable playbooks.
* Build scalable lifecycle campaigns that proactively guide customers toward key milestones using automation, segmentation, customer behavior, product telemetry, and lifecycle analytics.
* Own Customer Success digital reporting by developing scalable dashboards and reporting views for customer health, onboarding, adoption, product usage, engagement, renewals, expansion, and program effectiveness.
* Partner with Revenue Operations and Business Systems to improve data quality, reporting automation, and accessibility of customer insights across the Customer Success organization.
* Identify customer trends, risks, friction points, and growth opportunities through data analysis and translate insights into actionable recommendations for CS leadership and cross-functional partners.
* Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and Customer Success to accelerate adoption of Doppel ’s AI capabilities through targeted customer education, campaigns, usage analysis, and best-practice programs.
* Measure AI adoption and customer maturity through clear success metrics; identify barriers to adoption and recommend improvements to product experience, enablement, and customer engagement.
* Map, document, and continuously optimize the end-to-end digital customer journey using customer feedback, behavioral data, lifecycle analytics, and operational insights.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Enablement to create targeted email campaigns, learning content, webinars, in-product guidance, best-practice resources, and customer communications aligned to lifecycle stage and success milestones.
* Partner with Customer Success leadership to define and optimize customer health scoring, customer maturity frameworks, lifecycle processes, and standardized playbooks.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Customer Success workflows using AI, digital tools, and scalable operational processes.
* Track and report on key metrics including time-to-value, onboarding completion, product adoption, AI feature adoption, customer health, product usage and engagement, NPS/CSAT, renewal readiness, expansion influence, and digital program ROI.
* Conduct segmentation analysis and A/B testing to continuously improve digital customer engagement and program performance.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to advocate for customer needs and improve in-product guidance, self-service experiences, and customer adoption paths.
* Work with Sales and Account Management to align digital customer success programs with broader business initiatives, renewal planning, and growth opportunities.

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Program Management, Digital Customer Experience, Lifecycle Marketing, Revenue Operations, or a related SaaS function.
* Experience designing, launching, and scaling digital customer success programs for an existing customer base.
* Strong understanding of the SaaS customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, expansion, and advocacy.
* Experience building customer reporting, dashboards, and insights using data from CRM systems, product analytics tools, customer success platforms, support systems, and/or marketing automation platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, clean, structure, interpret, and communicate customer data from multiple sources.
* Experience with customer engagement, product analytics, or lifecycle tools such as HubSpot, Pendo, Docebo, Gainsight, Planhat, Vitally, or similar platforms.
* Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate data into clear recommendations for leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Comfort working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities evolve and ownership is important.
* A thoughtful, curious, and resourceful approach to problem solving.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, AI-driven products, or customer-facing technology environments is helpful but not required.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own server and rack-level production projects for large-scale AI datacenter infrastructure. This role connects capacity planning, hardware architecture, procurement, ODM manufacturing, logistics, and datacenter deployment teams.

You will make sure the right GPU, compute, and storage infrastructure is ordered, produced, delivered, and deployed on time. The role requires strong server hardware knowledge, structured project management, vendor coordination, and high ownership across adjacent work-streams.

Track adjacent processes such as POs, invoices, export licenses, payments, logistics bookings, and required documentation.
Provide regular production status, risk updates, and decision points to stakeholders.
Drive issue resolution across planning, procurement, production, testing, logistics, delivery, and deployment.
Continious improvements after each production cycle. Improve ODM requirements, supplier expectations, internal processes, reporting, and tooling. Gather deployment and operations feedback and convert it into future production improvements.

Experience managing complex hardware production, manufacturing, supply chain, infrastructure, or datacenter delivery projects.
Strong understanding of modern server architectures, especially high-performance GPU-based environments.
Knowledge of server components and ability to configure hardware for different service needs.
Ability to quickly adapt to new server platforms, components, and technologies.
Experience working with ODMs, OEMs, factories, hardware vendors, or contract manufacturers.
Experience with BOMs, component planning, production timelines, and factory execution.
Strong project management skills, including Gantt charts, milestones, dependencies, and risk tracking.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under tight deadlines.
Strong communication, negotiation, and vendor management skills.
High ownership, structured thinking, and ability to drive work-streams outside the narrow TPM scope.

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products, from supply chain and fulfillment through transportation, last mile delivery, and post-purchase resolution. AMXL currently operates across North America, Europe, Japan, and is expanding into emerging markets.

Within AMXL, the CX and Growth org is a centralized, worldwide team organized across five pillars designed to ensure that every customer who purchases a large, high-value product receives a reliable experience.
The Execution Excellence pillar is where planning meets the customer. It houses two complementary teams: our AMXL Operations Center and our AMXL Proactive Execution program.

These teams serve as the real-time network execution backbone, translating strategic decisions into daily network performance across our end-to-end network and also as the mechanism that identifies delivery failures before they become visible to the customer and intervenes proactively to save the delivery or manage the recovery directly with the customer.

Together, these teams form a closed loop: detect upstream, prevent where possible, intervene proactively where not, and feed root causes back so defects are resolved at the source.
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the integration and transformation of this combined organization. This is not a steady-state program management role. The program strategy is being built.

You will inherit a consolidation in progress and own the lifecycle of making it work: assessing what the combined org should look like, defining how we measure success, building the mechanisms that make it sustainable, and driving the hard conversations required to get there.

You will use process lifecycle evaluation methodologies to categorize the team's portfolio (automate, simplify, reallocate, or deprecate), and build automation roadmaps in partnership with technical teams.
This role requires someone who can operate in high ambiguity, make trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals, and communicate persuasively across teams. The right candidate sees automation and AI as something they use today, not something they plan to use later, and will set the standard for how this team uses technology to scale impact without scaling headcount.

· Define the operating model for the combined organization: org design, process rationalization, scope definition, and mechanisms that make it self-sustaining.
· Build the process lifecycle evaluation framework, determining which workflows to automate, simplify, reallocate, or retire, and manage the pipeline of new use cases from scoping through launch.
· Own the automation roadmap in partnership with data science, engineering, and technology teams, establishing accountability mechanisms with clear timelines for every manual process.
· Drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment across supply chain, quality, and operations, navigating complex organizational dynamics and building trust where needed.
· Scale this capability into new geographies by adapting the operating model to local carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and workforce availability.
A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics dashboards, identifying areas that need attention, and preparing a status narrative for a director-level review. By mid-morning you are facilitating a working session with partners to align on priorities for the quarter.

After lunch you dive into data to validate assumptions behind a proposed solution, then draft a decision document that frames trade-offs for leadership. You close the day mentoring a newer program manager and connecting with cross-regional counterparts to keep workstreams on track.

The AMXL Customer Experience and Growth team takes a 360-degree approach to the customer journey:
· **Eliminate**: detect, solve, and resolve customer-impacting issues upstream by providing relevant and timely insights for operations teams, transportation, and product development.
· **Automate**: continuously assess and identify opportunities to replace manual processes with automated, scalable solutions.
· **Optimize**: when a customer does need support, ensure AMXL stakeholders have the tools, resources, policies, and protocols to deliver a perfect experience.
The operations center translates strategic decisions into daily network performance. The proactive execution team ensures that when defects occur, customers are protected through early intervention. The Sr. Program Manager will be the link that makes both teams operate as one system.

## Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire ##
### Notre bureau ###
**Conti & Associés Ingénieurs SA** est un bureau d-ingénieurs spécialisé dans les techniques du bâtiment **CVSER**, implanté à **Versoix (Genève)** et **Perroy (Vaud)**.
Actifs depuis 1983, nous regroupons aujourd-hui plus de 35 collaborateurs et intervenons dans les domaines suivants :
· Chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC)
· Sanitaire
· Électricité
· Régulation / MCR et automatisme du bâtiment
Nous accompagnons nos clients sur l-ensemble des phases **SIA 108**, avec une activité importante sur les phases 3, 4 et 5 : études, appels d-offres, réalisation et réception des ouvrages. Nous intervenons également en phase 6 pour le suivi de l-exploitation et l-optimisation énergétique des bâtiments.
Notre activité couvre aussi les audits et diagnostics énergétiques, la physique du bâtiment, les études de faisabilité CVSER, les CECB+, les missions GED et AMOén dans le cadre du programme éco21, ainsi que les expertises techniques CVSER pour des assurances, maîtres d-ouvrage ou dans le cadre de procédures judiciaires.
### Le poste ###
Dans le cadre du développement de notre département Sanitaire, nous recherchons un(e) **Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire** capable de participer à la conception et au suivi de projets variés, de l'étude jusqu'à la réalisation.
### Vos missions ###
1/ **Études et conception**
a/ Concevoir et dimensionner les installations sanitaires conformément aux normes, directives et règles de l-art applicables en Suisse.
b/ Réaliser les études des réseaux d-eau froide, eau chaude sanitaire, bouclage, eaux usées et eaux pluviales.
c/ Réaliser les calculs et dimensionnements nécessaires aux projets.
d/ Élaborer les plans, schémas de principe et détails techniques.
2/ **Plans et soumissions**
a/ Réaliser et mettre à jour les plans sanitaires sous **AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Établir les quantitatifs et métrés nécessaires aux appels d-offres.
c/ Participer à l-élaboration des **soumissions CAN** à l-aide des outils spécifiques tels que **Plancal Nova / SNAP**.
d/ Participer à l-analyse technique des offres des entreprises.
3/ **Coordination et réalisation**
a/ Assurer la coordination technique avec les disciplines chauffage, ventilation, électricité et régulation.
b/ Participer aux séances avec les maîtres d-ouvrage, architectes, entreprises et autres mandataires.
c/ Participer au suivi de l-exécution des installations sur le terrain.
d/ Contrôler la conformité des installations avec les plans, normes et prescriptions du projet.
e/ Participer aux réceptions des installations et au suivi des réserves.
### Votre profil ###
1/ **Formation et expérience**
a/ CFC de projeteur(se) en technique du bâtiment sanitaire, technicien(ne) ES, maîtrise fédérale ou formation jugée équivalente.
b/ Expérience de plusieurs années dans un bureau d-ingénieurs, bureau d'études ou une entreprise sanitaire.
c/ Une expérience professionnelle en Suisse constitue un avantage important.
2/ **Compétences techniques**
a/ Bonne maîtrise d-**AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Connaissance de **Plancal Nova / SNAP** et des soumissions selon le **CAN sanitaire**.
c/ Bonne connaissance des normes et prescriptions sanitaires suisses.
d/ Connaissance des prescriptions **SSIGE** et des directives techniques **Geberit**.
e/ La maîtrise de **Revit / BIM** constitue un atout.
f/ Bonne maîtrise des outils MS Office.
### Vos qualités ###

s.h: Nous recherchons avant tout une personne
s.t:
· autonome dans les missions correspondant à son niveau d'expérience ;
· pragmatique et à l-aise avec la réalité du terrain
· capable de prendre des initiatives et des responsabilités
· appréciant le travail en équipe et les échanges entre disciplines
· ayant envie de progresser et de s-investir durablement dans notre bureau.
Selon votre expérience et votre degré d-autonomie, le poste pourra évoluer vers davantage de responsabilités et la gestion complète de projets sanitaires.
